blackout.title: The Blackout — live recovery drill
blackout.intro: Wipe part of the live database on purpose, then watch KrishiFlow rebuild it from its event journal and snapshots while new requests keep coming in.
blackout.unreachable: The console cannot reach the backend. Start the Node server on port 5000.
blackout.detectedLine: {{affected}} records affected · {{recoverable}} recoverable from the journal · {{unrecoverable}} beyond recovery

blackout.footnote: The drill only ever deletes or corrupts records tagged for the drill. Real accounts, vehicles, requests and postings are never touched.

vrpDemo.title: How dispatch routing works
vrpDemo.intro: One freighter, already on the road. A pickup request lands mid-run. Watch the cheapest place to slot it in get found — and the route redrawn under the truck.
vrpDemo.footnote: A scripted walk-through. The distances, times and costs are copied from a real dispatch run — see VRP.md.

step.drivingBody: The freighter is already driving Nashik → Pimpalgaon → Mumbai APMC, with 4,000 kg aboard and 3,000 kg to collect on the way.
step.requestBody: Kiran Thorat needs 2,500 kg of tomato moved from a Lasalgaon farm to Mumbai APMC. The farmer never picks a truck.
step.rankingBody: Every vehicle is priced by the extra road it would drive to serve this farmer. An idle van in Nashik would cover all 292 km from scratch; this freighter already passes Lasalgaon.
step.rerouteBody: Lasalgaon slots in between Pimpalgaon and Mumbai APMC. One leg is dropped, two are added, and the truck carries on — 55 km further, not 292.
